LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS : DEFENDANT SONYA SESSION'S MOTION TO MAKE PAYMENTS FOR JUDGMENT TO BE MADE TO THE SUPERIOR COURT OF SAN FRANCISCO IS DENIED. MOTION WAS SERVED AND FILED LESS THAN 16 DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING IN VIOLATION OF C C P 1005. THE MOTION APPEARS TO BE A POST JUDGMENT REQUEST AND POST JUDGMENT REQUESTS ARE NOT PROPER IN THIS DEPARTMENT. LOCAL RULE 10 CA (3). THE MOTION IS NOT SUPPORTED BY A MEMORANDUM OF POINTS AND AUTHORITIES AS REQUIRED BY C R C 3.1113 AND THE COURT CANNOT TELL ON WHAT AUTHORITY DEFENDANT REQUESTS RELIEF. NO OPPOSITION FILED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: WENDY PUN CSR# 12891 (301/PJB)
